description: The CLI --assignee rejects the only name the browser shows ('Setup agent' → UNKNOWN_ACTOR) and requires a handle (agent-<hex>-openai-codex) that appears nowhere in the UI.
expected: --assignee accepts an unambiguous display name, or the UI shows each Actor's handle (e.g. in the profile and the Assignee options).
suggested_fix: Resolve unique display names in resolveActor; show handles in the Actor profile dialog with a copy button.

description: Activity attributes the agent's create to 'Setup agent', which matches two different agents in this project (Daniel's and Priya's). Same root cause as F-059-01.
expected: Attribution identifies the specific agent (e.g. 'Setup agent (Daniel)').
actual: 'Setup agent created Add retry jitter to push registration'.
suggested_fix: Disambiguate duplicate Actor display names everywhere they render.

description: Tags input formats differ: the UI takes comma-separated text, while the CLI --tags rejects 'auth,ios' with '--tags must be valid JSON'.
expected: The CLI accepts comma text as well as JSON.
suggested_fix: Accept comma-separated --tags when the value is not JSON.
